title: Liquid Carat — Classic
subtitle: Round brilliants in a continuous line, moving with the wrist. No clasp, no closure.

stone.origin: Natural. No clasp — continuous flex setting.

description: The Liquid Carat™ at its most balanced — round brilliant diamonds in a continuous, no-clasp line engineered to move freely with the wrist. Without hinge or clasp the stones behave almost like liquid, pouring around the arm and shifting with every gesture of the hand. At its classic proportion the line carries real presence while staying supple and unforced, the light running unbroken from one end to the other. It is the piece that best expresses what the Liquid Carat™ was made to do. Made to order in the metal chosen at commission.
